name: Vedema Resort
positioning: Vedema, a Luxury Collection Resort: a wine-estate resort built around a 400-year-old winery in the medieval village of Megalohori, Santorini, laid out like a traditional fortified Greek village
best_for: Wine lovers who want a resort built around its own centuries-old winery and vineyards
Families looking for hands-on cultural experiences rooted in Santorini's traditions
Couples who want a suite or villa with its own terrace, jacuzzi or private pool

facts.text: The resort is tucked away within the medieval village of Megalohori and evolved from a 400-year-old wine cellar and a 100-year-old mansion.
The resort is built around the 400-year-old winery at the heart of the property and resembles a traditional fortified Greek village.
The resort sits on a more than 500-year-old vineyard overlooking Megalohori and was built in 1993.
Architect Mary Kavagia and interior designers Yiannis Tseklenis and Aggelos Aggelopoulos created the resort as a traditional fortified Greek village.
The name Vedema is the Venetian translation for 'harvest'.
The vineyards around the hotel produce their own vintage, which guests can taste in the Canava Wine Bar.
Interiors combine the angular lines of Cycladic architecture with island-sourced antique furnishings.
In all rooms, wooden doors open to a private terrace or patio overlooking the resort gardens.
Elios Spa is set in a 100-year-old wine cellar.
Elios Spa offers therapeutic massages, facials and body treatments.
Alati Restaurant is set in the 400-year-old winery cave with stone walls.
The Kinship Program offers families hands-on experiences rooted in Santorini's traditions.

highlights.text: All suites and villas have their own terraces, and many have jacuzzis or private pools.
The Nafsika Estate has caldera and sea views, a private pool and a whirlpool.
The sunset wine ceremony in the Canava Wine Bar is a tasting of 6 indigenous wines with Greek cheeses and crackers.
The concierge arranges daily excursions to the black, red and white beaches by private sailboat.
Guests can host a picnic on the resort's private beach.

considerations.text: The swimming pool is not heated.
Prive Dining's five- or seven-course degustation menus are available with an advance booking.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the luxury positioning.
